description.value: Xwísten Experience Tours is an Indigenous-owned cultural attraction operated by the St'át'imc people at the historic Bridge River fishing grounds six kilometres north of Lillooet. Visitors join guided walking tours of active salmon-drying sites and a pit-house archaeological village containing over 80 identified s7ístken (traditional winter homes). The on-site Bearfoot Grill rounds out the visit with burgers, sandwiches, salads, and local favourites served in a casual setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website subpages load successfully and confirm this is an active Indigenous cultural tourism operation run by the St'át'imc people near Lillooet, offering guided walking tours and a Bearfoot Grill restaurant on site. The contact page corroborates the OSM address exactly and adds a phone number and email not present in OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null. The OSM-linked URL (index.html) returns a 404, but the rest of the site functions normally.
concerns: The OSM website URL (http://www.xwistentours.ca/index.html) returns a 404; the working site root is http://www.xwistentours.ca/ — OSM URL should be updated.
OSM has no phone number; website lists 250-256-7844 (also displayed as +1-250-256-7844). Phone added from website.
OSM has no email; website lists tours@xwisten.ca.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Indigenous cultural tourism attraction with an active website, confirmed address, and on-site restaurant — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through Lillooet.

Café or food on site.detail: Bearfoot Grill is an on-site restaurant offering burgers, sandwiches, salads, and local favourites; BBQ Salmon meals are also served as part of tour packages
